name: office-space
description: Subagents as 16-bit office workers above the prompt, plus external workers from a watched folder. Toggle with /office-space.

workersDir.title: External workers folder
workersDir.description: Folder of worker JSON files to show in the office (OFFICE_SPACE_WORKERS_DIR overrides it).

staleMinutes.title: Stale after (minutes)
staleMinutes.description: An external worker not updated for this long is drawn faded; after 4x this long it leaves.
